lines.text: // Resource-compact cohort16 MLP input frontend.  One Hadamard32 pipeline and
// four robust A8 quantizers are time-multiplexed across all 16 requests.  The
// resulting bundle is committed atomically into two independent eight-row
// ping-pong caches.  This path runs while the other bank is consumed, so input
// latency is traded for the LUT/DSP headroom needed by the full board.
// The complete S24 transaction is retained while the folded Hadamard
// visits its sixteen rows.  Keep the same 12288 payload FFs, but give each
// physical row its own protected capture predicate.  A single in_fire CE
// previously reached all payload bits and Vivado promoted that data net to
// a BUFGCE (12373 non-clock loads in Run 0147).
// Net protection is required here: post-place phys_opt preserved the LUT1
// cells but reconnected their equivalent outputs into six device-wide CE
// trees.  Three independent 256-bit domains per row keep every protected
// CE below the data-BUFG promotion threshold.
// Keep completed rows in their final physical banks.  The previous
// variable part-select on one 4096-bit register caused Vivado to build
// multi-thousand-load write predicates (three data BUFG candidates in
// the first V5 place).  Sixteen explicit row banks make each payload
// write local; payload storage is intentionally not cleared because all
// sixteen rows are overwritten before bundle_valid_r may be asserted.
// Quantizers 0/1 own rows 0..7 and quantizers 2/3 own rows 8..15.
// This preserves four-way issue bandwidth while making each completed
// row half physically local to its corresponding eight-row cache.
// Both cache halves begin from identical state and receive identical tags.
// Present each transaction locally so no half-ready/half-valid signal must
// cross an SLR to qualify the other half.  The public ready/valid join and
// sticky mismatch checks below retain the atomic lockstep contract.
// Resource-folded S24 Q8.16 normalized Hadamard32 for the MLP input path.
// Butterfly arithmetic is bit-identical to hap_hadamard32_norm_stream.  Only
// four of the 32 S29xU14 normalization multiplies are issued per cycle; each
// multiplier maps to two DSP48E2 on VU9P, reducing the bank from 64 to 8 DSP.
// A fixed head removes a payload-wide read-pointer mux from both SLR
// crossings.  Tail moves into head only when a full FIFO drains.
// A transaction is presented to either local ingress only when the other
// branch also has credit.  Both local copies are consequently accepted on
// the same edge without a central S37 or kernel-result fork.  Branch credit
// controls only this FIFO's dequeue and cannot affect upstream in_ready.
// Each branch owns a two-entry down elastic queue below.  The central
// consumer therefore sees only queue heads; its ready no longer reaches
// either S54 accumulator through this atomic 16-row join.
// Scheme-A tensor boundary over a dedicated 256-bit AXI data master.
// Input is 128 contiguous cohort16 group32 records (48 beats/record); output
// is 256 contiguous cohort16 tile16 records (32 beats/record).
input wire clk,input wire rst_n,input wire clear,
input wire load_valid,output wire load_ready,input wire load_bank,
output wire busy,output reg done,output reg load_done,
output reg store_done,output wire store_armed,output wire axi_active,
// A 12288-bit shift register made rd_fire a 12288-load CE and Vivado
// promoted that data/control net onto a BUFGCE in the full V5 place.
// Store each AXI beat directly in its final 256-bit bank instead.  The
// bank decode has only 48 sinks and each local enable owns 256 FFs; the
// flattened tensor order at the MLP boundary is unchanged.
// Likewise, shifting a complete 8192-bit output tile on every accepted
// AXI beat created a second global data predicate.  Capture the 32 final
// words into protected banks and advance only a 256-bit registered stream
// word.  The per-bank hold bits are physical control copies; bit zero of
// output_tile_valid_r remains the sole architectural protocol owner.
// A stallable two-stage 32-to-1 read pipeline keeps the beat selector and
// data mux local.  It adds two startup cycles per tile but still retires
// one AXI beat per cycle once full.
// Keep bank 47's payload CEs separate from the logically equivalent
// MLP tensor and metadata DMA clients.
// Three AXI client bundles (c0 Attention, c1 tensor, c2 metadata).
